_comment: TRACKED TEMPLATE — the source of truth for every seat's Claude Code hooks and permission guards. Rendered into .claude/settings.local.json by 2_Project_Files/tools/render_claude_settings.py, which the launcher runs at every boot. WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: settings.local.json is gitignored (.gitignore:8), so on 2026-09-16 Tuesday's copy was 169 bytes of statusline against Wednesday's 1775 — she ran with ZERO of these hooks, including the PreCompact block, and zero permission guards. Nothing in PORTABILITY.md or doctor.sh mentioned it. A guard that cannot travel is a guard one seat has. Edit THIS file, never the rendered one; the renderer preserves each seat's own theme and statusLine and replaces only hooks + permissions. @WORKSPACE@ is substituted with the volume root of the seat's own tree.
